newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London steady, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London steady, trade thin.

text.p: Japanese shares were steady to slightly higher in cautious European trade as players awaited Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony later on Wednesday, dealers said.
"We haven't had a lot of business but there are a few buyers around," one dealer said. "But until Greenspan speaks, it will remain pretty quiet."

In Tokyo on Wednesday, shares ended sharply lower as unravelling of arbitrage-linked positions took their toll on cash stocks, brokers said. The Nikkei-225 share index fell 291.27 points or 1.57 percent to 18,273.51.
Honda Motor Co Ltd was the main feature in an otherwise quiet market, with the share benefiting from the stronger dollar, dealers said.

The share was trading at 3,860 yen in London after closing in Tokyo at 3,780 yen. Honda shares surged to a new intraday record high of 3,880 yen in Tokyo before retreating in-line with the Nikkei-225.
The dollar hit a 35-month high against the mark in Tokyo on Wednesday and was trading well above the 121 level against the Japanese yen by 1535 GMT.
"Honda has seen some good buying both in London and New York the past few days," one trader said. "The stronger dollar is seen as helping the export market."
